brand.name: Orange Jelly
brand.primary_category: Growth partner for ambitious small and mid-sized businesses
brand.core_proposition: You bring the growth problem. We build the solution.
brand.brand_idea: An unfair advantage for ambitious businesses.

vision: To help ambitious smaller businesses outthink and outperform much larger competitors.
mission: To expose what is blocking growth and make the right change happen using creativity, technology, AI and commercial judgement.

positioning.audience: Ambitious small and mid-sized businesses that have built something real, feel a growth ceiling and are ready to change.
differentiation: Starts with the business problem rather than a fixed service
Connects demand, conversion, margin, operations, experience and scale
Combines creativity, commercial thinking, technology and practical AI
Challenges and builds rather than advising and disappearing
Uses evidence and agreed success measures
not: AI consultancy selling technology for its own sake

audience.typical_size: Roughly 10 to 500 employees, with fit determined by complexity, budget, authority and ambition rather than headcount alone.
decision_makers: Transformation or innovation lead with authority

stages.name: HEAR
stages.purpose: Understand what is really happening, not only what the brief says.

stages.name: EXPOSE
stages.purpose: Find the pressure points, root causes and opportunities that matter.

stages.name: BUILD
stages.purpose: Design and implement the right practical solution.

stages.name: PROVE
stages.purpose: Measure the difference, improve the solution and embed what works.

voice.expletive_policy: Use partially censored expletives sparingly as high voltage in founder-led or manifesto content, never as decoration.
signature_lines: You bring the growth problem. We build the solution.
AI is part of the toolkit, not the product.
A content calendar will not fix a broken growth system.
Brilliant thinking is useless until it changes something.
Built for businesses big enough to have real growth problems and small enough to move fast.

search_vision: Show up when a serious business leader realises the problem is bigger than another quick fix.
proof_role_of_anchor: A live trading small-business laboratory that demonstrates transferable growth thinking, not a hospitality-only category boundary.
